en: A sepia-toned historical photograph showing a large crowd gathered in a city square. In the foreground, an older, bald man with a beard stands elevated above the crowd, smiling and gesturing as people surround him with flowers and wreaths. The background features multi‑storey European-style buildings with many windows. In the lower right corner, white handwritten-style text reads a caption and date.
